bio_am: Բուն անունով Արշակ Գաւաֆեան, ծնած է Կարին՝ 1862-ին։ Կամաւորական շարժման ընթացքին ինկաւ Րէվանդուզի ճակատամարտին եւ թաղուեցաւ Թիֆլիսի Խոջիվանքի գերեզմանատունը։
bio_en: Keri, born Arshak Gavafian in Karin (Erzurum) in 1862, fought for a quarter of a century for Armenian liberation. In 1898 he crossed into the Ottoman provinces with Sako, and in 1904 he was in Sasun beside Andranik. In Persia he rose with the constitutional movement and after Yeprem's death was made chief of the gendarmerie and commander of the constitutional army. During the First World War he led a volunteer regiment in the battles of Urmia, Soldouz, Soujbulagh and Ushnu, and was killed in the battle of Revanduz on the road to Mosul; his body was buried in Tiflis at Khojivank beside Zavarian and Duman.
notes: Compiled from the archive review, 2026-10-12. Confidence: high. #441 (Ashkhatank, Yerevan, 1st year, c.1916) gives birth 1858 in Karin, a shoemaker who joined Kukunian's expedition in 1890 at 28 - conflicts with #40's 1862. Death in 1916 consistent with Ashkhatank's first year in Yerevan.
